request: Please find me data regarding first-of-class ship cost overruns

reply.reply:
**CRS reports show Ford-class ship estimates rose 27.0%, 40.7%, and 28.0% through FY24; Columbia-class procurement estimates increased 15.2% from FY2021 to FY2025.**

- By FY24, estimates rose cumulatively +27.0%, +40.7%, and +28.0% for the three ships, respectively, since their listed actual procurement dates. (RS20643, PDF p. 14)
- The table lists first-boat SSBN-826 procurement cost at $16,121.3 million, versus $10,688.5 million for the second boat and $10,543.7 million for the third. (R41129, PDF p. 16)
- The FY2025 estimate for Columbia-class procurement was $126.4 billion, 15.2% above the FY2021 estimate of $109.8 billion. (R41129, PDF p. 15)
reply.reasoning: CRS provides useful cost-growth data for two major Navy ship classes. The comparisons have different scopes: ship-specific cumulative Ford estimates and total Columbia-class procurement estimates.
